comment: Colin Raffel 2006 analog bit crusher: J201 sample/hold clocked by an op-amp pulse oscillator, with op-amp input and output buffers. Op amp sections X1-X4 have no part number.
rows: op amps X1-X4 with no part number: one quad op amp, or (suggested) two duals, one for the buffers X1/X2 and one for the clock oscillator X3/X4
R9, drawn '1M-2M', wired as a variable resistor; 2M or more gives a lower frequency range
